items.text: Pick a Day theme and a Night theme; the sun and moon flip them.
Every theme has a partner one tap away. Your own can make theirs.
Shorter update notes, like this one.
A line shows its menu on hover or hold.
Fewer controls up top, and they fade while you work.
Your own theme can carry a sound.
Repeating lines, Not today, one-thing mode, search, templates, add from anywhere.
One Settings sheet, and delete a list everywhere with ten seconds to undo.
Sound on the iPhone after a call.
